story.titleZh: FIA对当前情况全面评估后决定，塞浦路斯拉力赛将成为2026年中东拉力锦标赛收官战
story.summaryZh: FIA经过全面评估，决定将原定于10月23日至25日举行的塞浦路斯拉力赛作为2026年中东拉力锦标赛的最后一轮。
story.originalTitle: The decision follows a comprehensive assessment of the current circumstances and associated challenges, while recognising the importance of ensuring t...
story.summaryEn:
The decision follows a comprehensive assessment of the current circumstances and associated challenges, while recognising the importance of ensuring the best possible organisational and operational conditions for all participants and relevant stakeholders.
As a result, Cyprus Rally, scheduled to take place from 23–25 October, will serve as the final round of the 2026 FIA Middle East Rally Championship 🇨🇾
#FIA #MERC
https://www.fia.com/news/cyprus-rally-set-conclude-2026-fia-middle-east-rally-championship-season
detailZh:
该决定是在全面评估当前情况及其相关挑战的基础上做出的，同时认识到确保所有参与者和相关利益相关者获得最佳组织和管理条件的重要性。
因此，原定于10月23日至25日举行的塞浦路斯拉力赛将成为2026年FIA中东拉力锦标赛的最后一轮。
